purpose: Independent verification of the round-04 published catalog and application behavior

suites.name: browser_e2e
suites.test_data: Playwright-configured local fixture API on 127.0.0.1:5399 and Vite server on 127.0.0.1:5388

limitations: The initial backend run in the restricted sandbox could not bind localhost for its HTTP-server test; the identical command was rerun with approved localhost binding and passed.
The E2E suite used the repository's isolated fixture API and Vite servers on ports 5399 and 5388; no production database was used or modified.
Shell emitted harmless pyenv shim rehash permission warnings; Playwright emitted color-environment warnings.
